Independent review of run r-20260929T072914346236-srw-watch-help-names-its-default at head 3c8f86e4fbf9b41d5f7634c35b635075143046e3 against base 41ef8974aee89b85dc8cd941454ec20ca1a8fc6d. The node repairs the defect plan section 10 names: the agent watch --record help text still named ~/.local/share/ambix/receipts as the default after the reader's default had moved to the site configuration, so the help pointed a reader at a directory nothing writes — an empty record indistinguishable from a lane that served nothing.

Goal fidelity. The help now reads 'Receipts directory to read (default: the site's receipts directory, resolved by watch.default_record_dir through the site configuration).' I verified the claim at runtime, not just by reading: default_record_dir() returns SiteConfig.from_env().receipts_dir, both bearing /work/projects/imas_gpu/agents/receipts, the directory the deployed recorder is launched against (slurm.py:506,778 pass _RECEIPTS_DIR={site.receipts_dir}) and which holds 80 live record files. The reader's default and the recorder's write directory are the same directory by construction, and the help now says so.

Independent verification. I re-ran the declared gate at 3c8f86e4 under the shared interpreter with module.__file__ printed inside the reviewed worktree: 2 passed, the serving-interpreter parse guard 1 passed, and ruff check imas_ambix tests All checks passed. A direct CliRunner render at head confirms stale path present: False, names default_record_dir: True.

Scope and records. The diff is the three declared paths only (cli.py help, a new test file, a 4-line fragment), 50 insertions and 1 deletion, with no plan metadata and no figure, and the worktree is clean at the reviewed head. The reviewed manifest is complete and check-manifest reports ok with no findings; its negative-control log opens with the declared mutation verbatim and is red for that reason, and its follow_on is accurate as far as it goes. Two findings: the new tests pin the help's wording without asserting that the named symbol still exists or that the resolution chain still ends at the site directory, so the guard cannot tell a rename from a repair; and the committed fragment has no trailing newline. One follow-on stands out beyond the node's scope: the agent receipts subcommand still spells the home receipts directory in running code at cli.py:2630-2634, which is a writer/reader divergence, not only a stale help string.
